messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> HIGH severity: Observability gap detected for tenant 'corp-z' (enterprise VPC / dedicated pool). Traces not appearing in Datadog since ~02:12 UTC, p95 latency spike observed. Thread created 1898765432. Paging @maria (sre-oncall) and on-call rotation.

maria (sre-oncall): Ack. Investigating. Quick question — are application logs still arriving for corp-z?

raj (eng-runtime): I can see request logs hitting the tenant forwarder, but trace payloads return 403 from the observability write endpoint. Suspect ephemeral token/role issue. Looking at forwarder logs now.

leah (platform-ops): Confirmed in forwarder logs: several 403s starting 02:10 UTC with "AccessDenied" when calling observability ingest. Forwarder container id: fwdr-corpz-71b2.

olivia (customer-success): Customer on the line. They say they can't correlate errors without traces — asking for ETA. They're sensitive about SLA credits.

kevin (infra): Quick note: we rolled a token rotation yesterday that shortens STS lifetime for per-tenant forwarders. Possible race where new token wasn't propagated to all dedicated pool nodes. Will validate config.

maria (sre-oncall): Can someone spin a temporary token/proxy so we can validate end-to-end? If we can get traces flowing again, we can reduce customer impact while we dig into root cause.

kevin (infra): Creating a short-lived proxy token and attaching to forwarder. Posting temp steps here (will expire in 15m):

```
# create temp proxy token for corp-z forwarder
export TEMP_TOKEN="eyJhbGc...tmp-token-..."
curl -X POST "https://internal-proxy.redwood/tenants/corp-z/forward" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEMP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"test_trace":{"trace_id":"0001","spans":[{"name":"test","duration_ms":5}]}}'
```

maria (sre-oncall): Sending test trace via proxy...

```
# output on forwarder
POST /tenants/corp-z/forward -> 200 OK
forwarder: enqueued trace id=0001 -> observed by datadog ingestion at 02:16:12 UTC
```

raj (eng-runtime): I can now see test traces in Datadog for corp-z. Good — proxy confirms token was the blocker. However, historical traces (the missing window) are not present; metrics still show a delay because our partition reingest hasn't run.

leah (platform-ops): We can reingest from S3 where the forwarder spool landed the raw trace payloads. Need a temporary role granting read access to the tenant bucket to run reingest job. ETA to start: ~5m after role is ready. Run time estimate ~20-30m depending on volume.

kevin (infra): Creating IAM reingest role with limited scope. Snippet (temp credentials will be rotated):

```
{
  "RoleName": "reingest-corp-z-temp",
  "Description": "Temp role for trace reingest - expires in 30m",
  "Permissions": ["s3:GetObject"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-tenant-logs/corp-z/*"
}
```

kevin (infra): Role created; credentials posted to secure channel. Grant valid 30m.

leah (platform-ops): Starting reingest job now (job id rgst-2026-03-15-01). Progress updates every 5m. First batch shows ~12% of missing traces reingested.

olivia (customer-success): Updated customer: temporary proxy is restoring live traces. Reingest in progress; shared ETA ~30m. Customer appreciates quick mitigation but asked why tokens expired unexpectedly — they want root cause and timeline.

maria (sre-oncall): Preliminary root cause: leader-election edge case in the per-tenant forwarder rollout meant some dedicated pool nodes held onto old STS creds after rotation. Token rotation completed but propagation failed to all nodes. Mitigation steps: 1) proxy token to restore flow 2) reingest missing traces 3) rollback token lifetime change for tomorrow's cycle. Patch to leader-election logic + more robust credential refresh on next deploy.

raj (eng-runtime): I'll own the postmortem and the code patch. Assigning to eng-runtime + infra + platform-ops. Will include test that simulates rolling rotations.

maria (sre-oncall): Reducing paging severity — impact limited to trace visibility (metrics still captured at coarse granularity). Handoff to raj for overnight watch. I'm offline in ~10m.

raj (eng-runtime): Ack, taking over. Will monitor reingest progress and confirm customer sees full visibility restored.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (proxy token + reingest started). Customer impact reduced. Next automated update scheduled in 30m or on reingest completion.

maria (sre-oncall): :thumbsup: thanks everyone. Postmortem owner: raj (eng-runtime). Timeline + remediation planned.
